caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a wooden tool resembling a large caliper or compass. It consists of two elongated, cylindrical legs that are joined at the top by a pivot, allowing them to open and close. One leg is straight, while the other is set into a curved element that looks somewhat like a protractor or a section of an arch, with an open space in the middle. The tool is primarily colored in shades of brown, imitating the appearance of wood. At the bottom of the left leg, there is a small band colored light yellow or tan, seemingly wrapped around the end. The background is plain and beige, with some minor brownish stains or marks visible. There is a small inscription or label in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Shaker Compass
